4.25 Revision of SION by NC
Norms Committee may identify SIONs which in its opinion are required to be
reviewed. Exporters are required to submit revised data in ANF 4B for such revision.
It is mandatory for industry / exporter(s) to provide production and consumption
data etc. as may be required by DGFT / EPC for revision of SION. Otherwise, applicant
shall not be allowed to take benefit of Advance Authorisation scheme.
